message: salvo_core::handler::tests::test_hooped_handler_without_type_parameter asserts nothing - it can only fail by panicking
why: Compile-time regression test named for its purpose: `let _handler: HoopedHandler = hello.hooped();` ascribes the type, which is the whole verdict; a runtime assert would add nothing.

message: salvo_serde_util::tests::test_serde_rename_rule_from_str asserts nothing - it can only fail by panicking
why: `s.parse::<RenameRule>().unwrap()` on every RENAME_RULES entry is the verdict - the test fails whenever from_str regresses to Err; unwrap/expect on an SUT result is the idiomatic Rust assertion.

message: salvo_oapi::openapi::schema::number::tests::test_eq_is_reflexive_for_nan asserts an expression against itself
why: Not a tautology: Number has a hand-written PartialEq comparing float bit patterns, so `assert_eq!(nan, nan)` can fail (f64 NAN != NAN) and is the Eq reflexivity law the test names.

message: salvo_cache::tests::test_cache sleeps 6s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky

message: salvo_cache::moka_store::tests::test_moka_store_builder sleeps 2s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky

message: salvo_cache::moka_store::tests::test_eviction_listener sleeps 0.05s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: The sleep is the backoff of a bounded poll loop that breaks as soon as `evicted` is set - this is synchronizing on the condition, which is what the rule asks for.

message: salvo_cache::moka_store::tests::test_weigher_bounds_by_bytes sleeps 0.05s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: Same bounded poll loop: the 50ms sleep is retry backoff and the loop exits on the eviction flag, so the test does not wait a fixed wall-clock span.

message: salvo_core::conn::stream::handshake::tests::handshake_completing_after_the_deadline_is_rejected sleeps 0.04s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: 40ms of real time to lapse a 10ms handshake deadline; every timer in HandshakeStream is a tokio Sleep, so `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]` makes the lapse instant and exact.

message: salvo_core::conn::stream::straight::tests::idle_timeout_fires_even_when_late_data_arrives sleeps 0.04s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
